codex.method: Codex session_meta subagent source, response_item function_call names, and MCP/tool names where available. Subagent jsonl that replays parent token_count history is not billed — that usage already sits on the parent session. Genuine subagent turns after a dump are billed from last_token_usage. Raw prompts, arguments, and outputs are not exported.
